source: ours (RimWorld has no grime on bodies; sneed 2026-11-16)
note: Dirt and blood on bodies, clothes and melee weapons, each 0 (clean) to 1 (docs/design/grime.md). Times are game seconds (one step; 30 a real second at 1x, so 9000 is 5 real minutes). A metre walked counts as a second. soil: bare soil, sand, rough stone dust the legs up to soilMax; mud and marsh cake them to 1. work: digging, planting, cutting, building, butchering, beating fires. ground: lying or crawling on bare ground (downed, dead). Blood: a wound that bleeds adds bloodPerDamage per point of damage in the body's own fluid; the melee attacker who drew it gets spatterPerDamage and its weapon weaponPerDamage. Rain (rainRate 1) under the open sky washes all of it in rainWashSeconds; ankle-deep water washes the legs, waist or chest deep the body too, swimming everything; without water it wears off in wearOffSeconds (not off a corpse).
